note: droit de vente des porteurs d'actions de série C historiques éteint le 25 septembre 2025 (cours moyen pondéré sur 20 jours d'au moins 68,16 $ hors période de blocage de Coatue Management) ; reclassement de 1,2 Md$ des fonds propres intermédiaires vers les capitaux propres ; aucun paiement
quote: holders of CoreWeave, Inc.'s (the "Company") legacy Series C convertible preferred stock (the "Put Shares") had a "put" right on the first trading day immediately after March 31, 2027 (the "Public Sale Date") that would require the Company to repurchase the Put Shares at a price per share of $38.95 payable in cash, representing an aggregate payment of $1.2 billion.
